Two button ingots of Nb-15Si-22Ti-2Al-2Hf-2V-2Cr (2Cr alloy) and Nb-15Si-22Ti-2Al-2Hf-2V-14Cr (14Cr alloy), each with a weight of 1500 g, were prepared by vacuum non-consumable arc melting (AC) in a copper water-cooled crucible under high purity argon atmosphere with a tungsten electrode. The button ingots were melted six times to ensure chemical homogeneity.

The assemblage was set into the induction coil of a vertical Bridgman furnace with argon atmosphere, below the induction coil there was a liquid-metal pool for cooling. Heated at 190 0 /C14 C for 20 min, the assemblage was withdrawn from the in-duction coil and subsequently quenched in the pool with a liquid GaeIneSn bath when the withdrawal distance reached 150 mm, while withdrawing rates of 18 mm/min and 36 mm/min were employed.
